metadata.title: Integer decomposition property of three-dimensional smooth polytopes: a shorter proof
metadata.abstract: Oda's smoothness conjecture asserts that every smooth lattice polytope has the integer decomposition property. The three-dimensional case of this conjecture was recently proven by AI. Here we give a much shorter proof of this result.

analysis.topic: 度量测度几何、极限与奇异空间
analysis.progressType: 三维 Oda 结果的较短证明
analysis.workSummary: 为三维光滑格多面体具有整数分解性质这一已获证明的结论，给出更短的证明。本文讨论的是三维情形，不声称解决任意维度的 Oda 光滑性猜想。
analysis.breakthrough: 简化三维整数分解性质的证明，提升已知结果的可读性。
analysis.limitations: 限三维光滑格多面体；摘要所述先前 AI 证明属于既有工作。
analysis.priorityReason: 格多面体重要结论的短证明有阅读价值
